Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Peer PE

Peer PE is back! Join SAAC as we host middle- and high-school students for a morning of movement and fun! Wear RED and plan to be active! Your role as volunteer is flexible; please come-and-go as your schedule allows. Logistics: November 3, 9:30-11 am, Location: Kuyper fieldhouse

Disc Golf Intramurals

Disc Golf Sign-Ups Are Open! Join us for three weeks of friendly competition and fun on the course. 

Disc Golf Intramurals now offers flexible scheduling! Teams can play their weekly round on any day and time that works for them, as long as it takes place during the designated competition week. Participants must submit their tee time before playing and complete one round each week of the three-week competition. Rounds cannot be played ahead or combined into a single week 

Register today! Sign up here: Disc Golf Intramural Sign-Ups – Fill out form

Writer's Reading Series with Dr. Kate Nesbit

Join Geisler Library for the next installment in the Writer's Reading series featuring Dr. Kate Nesbit, Associate Professor of English. Dr. Nesbit will read selections from her book, Willful Listeners: Reading Aloud and the Politics of Attention from Austen to Audiobooks . Wednesday, November 4th at 4:30 PM in the Graham Conference Center/ Bette Brunsting Room. Light refreshments and snacks will be provided. Enjoy an inspiring evening celebrating literature and creative writing on campus!

Voting in Pella

How to vote on November 3: 
Registered to vote in Pella? The voting location for Central College is United Methodist Church, 1414 University St 

Going home to vote? Use this link to find your place to vote! 

Not registered to vote? Not registered to vote in Pella? Never fear, you can still vote on election day! Click here to understand how to do same day voting. Students can download their housing lease to show proof of their Pella address: 

Student.central.edu, Log in, Under Resident Life, Click Housing Agreement, Download and print 

All Iowa voting locations have the same hours: 7am - 8pm ! Be in line by 8pm and you will get to vote. 

If you have any questions, stop in at the Student Development Office!

Meals from the Heartland with SSS

SSS is sponsoring , Meals from the Heartland , which is a non-profit organization from Des Moines that packs & sends meals to folks all over the world! Our service project will take place in the Central College field house on the West end of the indoor track on Thursday, November 12, 2026 . Sign up to pack meals or you can also be a table leader that helps fill the buckets. This is a fun event!!! 😊 
Shift 1 : 9:30-10:45 am - 60 people packing meals plus 5 table leaders 

Shift 2 : 11:00 am -12:15 pm - 60 people packing meals plus 5 table leaders 

Thank you!!

Fun Service Opportunities! Green Pod Hours!

Mark your calendar for some volunteer opportunties that count for green pod hours! It will be a great time in community & making a difference in the world. Join us as we serve 11/9 from 5 to 6:30 pm at the Pella Food Shelf. Use the link below to reserve your spot: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q2jhNfSLPQ4DDH2Xr2C28F7Nq11HH8UNohPgIi7S1_4/edit?usp=sharing

Interested in building your resume, growing as a leader, and making a difference at Central?

You can do all that and more by becoming an RA! Click here for more information on the job and to appy. Please note that you need to logged into Handshake in order to view the job listing . Benefits include a partial room waiver, a double-as-a-single room at no extra charge, and a flexible work schedule. See your RA or area coordinator if you have questions!

CROSS CON27! St. Louis over New Years Eve!!

Let's head to THE DOME in St. Louis over New Years Eve! Join us 12/31-1/3 for a conference with thousands of your peers learning from scripture, hearing from famous Bible teachers like David Platt Kevin DeYoung, & John Piper, worshiping with artists Matt Boswell & The Worship Initiative, & a day of sightseeing in St. Louis. Early-bird discount is $180 by 11/4 & final deadline of $200 by 11/16. 
sign up here: https://forms.gle/Sp4rucYfiy6y1tyy8 

more info here: https://www.crosscon.com/

Looking to play intramurals but don't have a team?

No problem! If you're interested in participating, fill out the spreadsheet linked below with your name, email, and the sport(s) you'd like to play. Don't miss your chance to get involved, meet new people, and participate in intramurals this semester!

YOU’RE INVITED! 
Join us for FCA tomorrow, 11/3 , to hear from guest speaker Tim Brand! We’ll be meeting in the BMW rooms at 8 PM . Hope to see you there!

Professional Networking Event

Join us on Thursday, Nov. 5th at 6 pm in the President's Dining Room for a night to learn about a career of your choice! Sign up by sending your name & the professional career choice to Matt at diehlm@central.edu. You will eat your meal with your professional and other college students. Open to all! Sponsored by SSS.

Entrepreneur Speaker Series 11/2 Alie Muller-Heit

Please join the BCOMM department in welcoming Ali Muller-Heit of Thistles Flower Market. 
Her speaking engagement will be 11/2 at 3pm in the BMW rooms. 

Alie Muller-Heit is the proud owner of Thistles Flower Market, a coernstone of Pella's downtown for over 40 years. With a passion for planning personalized moments, Alie loves creating meaningful designs for customers and brides alike.
